highlights.reason_zh: Claude Code 修补多处权限与沙箱边界；稳定版值得升级，但 Bash 默认审批变化可能让无人值守任务等待人工确认。
highlights.reason_en: Claude Code closes several permission and sandbox gaps; the stable update is worth adopting, but a Bash approval-default change can pause unattended jobs.

highlights.reason_zh: Metal Sandbox 把 Apple Silicon Mac 组织成可调度的 coding-agent 集群，并公开代码；小规模作者实验和非恶意多租户定位限制了结论。
highlights.reason_en: Metal Sandbox turns Apple Silicon Macs into a schedulable coding-agent cluster with public code; small author-run tests and non-hostile tenancy limit the claim.

highlights.reason_zh: United 的正式限制说明交易型 agent 还受服务方授权约束；公告没有公开授权接口，自动订票应继续等待。
highlights.reason_en: United's formal restriction shows that transactional agents still depend on service-side authorization; with no public interface, automated booking should wait.

highlights.reason_zh: Haru-4B 用开放权重和本地实现降低全双工语音试验门槛；独立对话质量、安全与打断评测仍缺。
highlights.reason_en: Haru-4B lowers the barrier to full-duplex voice trials with open weights and local implementations; independent quality, safety and interruption evidence is still missing.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并读完，并补搜模型、开发工具、开源、小团队、研究、基础设施、政策与重大综合新闻。Metal Sandbox 从上一轮暂缓项补录；United 限制与小团队 Haru-4B 由召回自检补录，三者均为 late discovery。Metal 性能证据仍限于作者小集群；United 只有日期精度且执行效果未独立测试；Haru 缺独立语音质量、安全与打断评测。Arete-27B 到期复核没有找到独立跨地区盲评。本轮没有重大综合新闻补充。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read, with active discovery across models, developer tools, open source, small teams, research, infrastructure, policy and major general news. Metal Sandbox was recovered from the prior deferred item, while United's restriction and small-team Haru-4B came from recall review; all three are late discoveries. Metal evidence remains limited to the authors' small cluster, United has date-only precision and untested enforcement, and Haru lacks independent voice-quality, safety and interruption evaluation. The due Arete-27B review found no independent cross-regional blinded evaluation. No major general-news supplement was selected.
